text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer? I'm sorry, did I give you a
fright?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My parents run a boxing gym, you see. If
I ever
need to concentrate, there's
nothing more
effective than this.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Say, Trainer, if you'd be up for it,
how
about being my partner for some
mitt work?
